probe.title: Raise your voice against HIV stigma
probe.text_sample: Raise your voice against HIV stigma Go to main content ↓ Menu Play the video Play the video Stigma Disclosure Community Raise your voice Resources Explore 2024 Campaign Switch to Close Raise your voice against HIV stigma In a world where stigma still whispers and shouts, how we respond becomes an act of love. Play the video Play the video Stigma Stigma Play the video Play the video Spot it. Stop it. Stigma takes many forms. Sometimes it’s loud and unmistakable; other times it hides in the quiet moments. But no matter how it shows up, stigma causes harm. Each of us has a role in challenging it—by speaking up, staying informed, and leading with empathy. Play the video Play the video Stigma Identifying Stigma Language. Words rooted in fear, blame, or outdated thinking—like “clean” or “risky”—reinforce stigma and make HIV harder to talk about. Misinformation. False or outdated ideas about transmission, treatment, or what it means to live with HIV continue to fuel fear and misunderstanding. Stereotypes. Narrow ideas about who is impacted by HIV overlook real experiences and keep harmful narratives alive. These assumptions affect access, relationships, and the support people receive. Mor
